title: 第17章 B轮投资协定第18章 本我自我超我
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
第二十八天清晨，苏醒像往常一样走进食堂，却在人群中一眼瞥见了个熟悉的身影
——那人一见到他，立刻从座位上弹起来，用力挥舞着手臂，脸上洋溢着难以抑制的兴奋。
“叶凡？”
苏醒微微一愣，随即笑着走上前去，“看来你通过觉醒仪式了，恭喜啊。”
两人在餐桌旁坐下，叶凡迫不及待地推过来一份已经打好的免费早餐：
两个烤得焦香的肉饼，一碗浓稠的燕麦粥，还有几片黑面包。
叶凡嘴里塞满了肉块，含糊不清地说：“嘿嘿，我觉醒了白银火枪手。”
他咽下食物，眼睛发亮地补充道：“我还觉醒了天赋，天赋是……”
苏醒立即抬手打断了他，神色严肃：“不要告诉我你的天赋是什么。
这是每个人最大的秘密，记住，对谁都不要说。”
他的声音压得很低，但眼中的认真让叶凡不由得点了点头。
苏醒打量着眼前这个少年——凌乱的黑发，瘦削但已经开始结实起来的身板，还有那双总是闪着倔强光芒的眼睛。
他心里泛起一阵波澜：这小子该不会真的拿到主角模板了吧？
父母双亡，从小受人欺负，要不是自己罩着，恐怕早就被揍得鼻青脸肿。
现在又觉醒了战斗职业，还获得了天赋……
越想越觉得不对劲。
穿越这种事都能发生在自己身上，遇见个天命之子又有什么好奇怪的？
苏醒的思绪飘回到上次叶凡被绑架的事——如果不是自己这个穿越者多留了个心眼，
而是像原主那样的小男孩，肯定傻乎乎地跑去救人，恐怕现在尸体都凉了。
而叶凡呢？大概率会被罗天威救下，进入那位大人的视线，然后觉醒成功……

一股寒意突然窜上苏醒的脊背，让他不由自主地打了个冷颤，仿佛整个食堂的温度都下降了几度。
他暗暗下定决心：得离这小子远一点。
以前看小说时就知道，待在主角身边的人多半没什么好下场。
但也不能得罪他，毕竟这可是疑似天命之子的人物。
苏醒舀起一勺燕麦粥，故作随意地问道：“你觉醒了，店长就没表示表示？”
“店长给了我100金币奖励，还把我调进了行动队。”
叶凡兴奋地说，肉屑随着他说话喷到桌面上，“所以才能和全哥一起吃饭啊。”
苏醒点点头，心里却泛起疑问：同样是白银职业，为什么自己能获得罗天威的第二轮投资，而叶凡却没有？
难道火枪手和剑士还有高下之分？他忍不住问道：“你这个火枪手职业，用枪有什么特殊加成吗？”
“当然有加成了！
关键是可以用枪了啊！”
叶凡说得理所当然，看到苏醒疑惑的表情，才恍然大悟地解释道：
“全哥你不知道吗？只有枪手职业才能用枪啊。
只有我们这个职业才能用精神能量点燃火药，激发子弹。
其他职业就算拿着枪也开不了火。”
苏醒一时语塞，心中暗骂道：“妈的，这是什么发癫的世界规则……”
他对这个世界的认知又一次被刷新了。
苏醒打定主意，以后要对叶凡采取“友好的远离，礼貌的疏远”
策略，尽量不和这个姓叶的小子待在一起。
饭后，苏醒来到三楼的大训练场，昨晚他申请了目标达成测试，今天是来展示成果的。

训练场里已经有两个人等在那里，一个是特别行政助理罗璇轩，一个是饭店安全部副部长李强。
content_en:
On the early morning of the 28th day, Su Xing walked into the cafeteria as usual, but caught a glimpse of a familiar figure in the crowd.
——As soon as the man saw him, he immediately jumped up from his seat, waving his arms vigorously, his face filled with uncontrollable excitement.
"Ye Fan?"
Su Xing was stunned for a moment, then walked forward with a smile, "It seems you have passed the awakening ceremony, congratulations."
The two sat down at the dining table, and Ye Fan couldn't wait to push over a ready-made free breakfast:
Two perfectly roasted meatloaf, a bowl of thick oatmeal, and a few slices of brown bread.
Ye Fan's mouth was filled with pieces of meat and he said vaguely: "Hey, I awakened the Silver Musketeer."
He swallowed the food and added with bright eyes: "I also awakened my talent, and my talent is..."
Su Xing immediately raised his hand to interrupt him, with a serious look on his face: "Don't tell me what your talent is.
This is everyone's biggest secret, remember, don't tell anyone. "
His voice was very low, but the seriousness in his eyes made Mark couldn't help but nodded.
Su Xing looked at the young man in front of him - messy black hair, thin but beginning to strengthen his body, and eyes that always shone with stubbornness.
There was a wave of confusion in his heart: Could this kid really get the protagonist template?
Both of his parents are dead, and he has been bullied since he was a child. If he hadn't protected him, he would have been beaten black and blue.
Now I have awakened the combat profession and gained talents...
The more I thought about it, the more something felt wrong.
Time travel can happen to me, so what's so strange about meeting a destiny's son?
Su Xing's thoughts drifted back to the last time Ye Fan was kidnapped - if he hadn't been more cautious as a time traveler,
But a little boy like the original owner must have foolishly ran to save people. I'm afraid the body is cold now.
And what about Ye Fan? There is a high probability that he will be rescued by Luo Tianwei, enter the sight of that adult, and then awaken successfully...
A chill suddenly ran up Xing Xing's back, making him shiver involuntarily, as if the temperature of the entire cafeteria had dropped a few degrees.
He secretly made up his mind: stay away from this kid.
When I read novels before, I knew that most of the people who stayed around the protagonist would not end well.
But you can't offend him, after all, this is a person who is suspected of being the son of destiny.
Su Xing scooped up a spoonful of oatmeal and asked casually, "You're awake, but the store manager didn't say anything?"
"The store manager gave me a 100 gold coin reward and transferred me to the action team."
Ye Fan said excitedly, meat crumbs spraying onto the table as he spoke, "That's why I can eat with Brother Quan."
Su Xing nodded, but doubts arose in his mind: He was also in the silver profession, why could he get a second round of investment from Luo Tianwei, but not Ye Fan?
Are there any differences between musketeers and swordsmen? He couldn't help but ask: "As a musketeer, do you have any special bonuses when using guns?"
“Of course there are bonuses!
The key is that you can use the gun! "
Ye Fan said it matter of course. Seeing Su Xing's confused expression, he suddenly understood and explained:
"Brother Quan, don't you know? Only gunners can use guns.
Only our profession can use spiritual energy to ignite gunpowder and inspire bullets.
Other professions cannot fire even if they hold a gun. "
Su Xing was speechless for a moment and cursed in his heart: "Damn it, what kind of crazy world rules are these..."
His understanding of the world was refreshed once again.
Su Xing made up his mind to adopt a "friendly distance and polite distance" from Ye Fan in the future.
Strategy, try not to stay with this boy named Ye.
After dinner, Su woke up and went to the large training ground on the third floor. He applied for the goal achievement test last night and was here to show the results today.
There are already two people waiting there in the training ground, one is the special administrative assistant Luo Xuanxuan, and the other is the deputy director of the hotel security department.Chang Li Qiang.
